records.title: MoE-DP: An MoE-Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Robust Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Skill Decomposition and Failure Recovery
records.reason: The full text is a robot visuomotor diffusion policy with MoE skill decomposition and inference-time action control. Here inference-time control refers to robotic action sequencing, not LLM inference systems.

records.title: MathAgent: Adversarial Evolution of Constraint Graphs for Mathematical Reasoning Data Synthesis
records.reason: The paper synthesizes mathematical reasoning training data using evolving constraint graphs. Its contribution is training-data generation, not inference-time efficiency or serving.

records.title: VAUQ: Vision-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LVLM Self-Evaluation
records.reason: VAUQ evaluates uncertainty calibration/self-evaluation for vision-language models; the contribution is reliability rather than resource reduction.

records.title: MedEinst: Benchmarking the Einstellung Effect in Medical LLMs through Counterfactual Differential Diagnosis
records.reason: MedEinst is a medical differential-diagnosis benchmark for measuring reasoning bias; it does not propose inference optimization.

records.title: The Illusion of Specialization: Unveiling the Domain-Invariant "Standing Committee" in Mixture-of-Experts Models
records.reason: The paper analyzes routing in MoE language models and reports domain-invariant frequently activated experts, which may inform conditional-computation efficiency. It is post-hoc diagnosis, not inference routing optimization or serving gains.
